message.content:
Since the basil plants are identical, the only thing that matters is how many plants go on each of the 3 different window sills.

Let

\[
x_1+x_2+x_3=6
\]

where \(x_1,x_2,x_3\) are the numbers of plants on the three window sills. Each \(x_i\) can be any nonnegative integer.

Using stars and bars, the number of nonnegative integer solutions is

\[
\binom{6+3-1}{3-1}=\binom{8}{2}=28.
\]

The answer is 28.
